$comment: The dashboard's own tsconfig, separate from the root one because the two target
different runtimes. The root tsconfig is Node: `types: [node]`, no DOM. This one is a
browser: DOM lib, no Node types. Sharing one config would mean the Lambda code could
typecheck against browser globals and this code against node:process.
